common_operations.A1: if q=max(0,floor(g/2)-1)>0, every legal configuration uses the same seeds, farthest + endpoint-floor cone, nonnegative fallback, standard rows, top-two view and forward-A ownership transfer; a conditional witness buy that tightens the cutoff discards the partial pass and restarts, while only the final accepted rows are published and counted
common_operations.witness_scheduler: after preprocessing, every legal configuration constructs the same scheduler with rent=0; A1 and ordinary D continuously pay queue-pop/edge-relax rent, each profile substitutes only its own witness vertex count into the same buy formula t*((3^k-1)/2+3^k), and every buy calls the same EvaluateWitnessTree implementation

abhss_configuration.execution_relation: the profiles share common A1/D/low-A operations; every remaining difference is either a safe added certificate or a same-role replacement; Base has no logical state family without an Enhanced counterpart or replacement
safe_additions: directed-cut dual-feasibility certificate outside A1 in the ordinary max stack and adjoint reduced/prefix checks

same_role_replacements.distance_root_initialization: BootstrappedBounded -> CompletePotential; both are selected realizations of one BuildDistanceRootInitialization call and return the same {group_distance, root, feasible upper} contract. The canonical SPT union is private cutoff bootstrap work inside the bounded realization, while full-distance expansion is private work inside the complete realization.
same_role_replacements.high_completion_after_A1: forward high A -> common A1 plus adjoint high H; when q>0, ell=min(1,q) keeps only the required common A1 forward prefix and H realizes logical layers 2..q
same_role_replacements.upper_witness: root-path tree -> primal upper plus dual-primal tree; both preprocessing paths only construct their witness and do not unconditionally evaluate it, then enter the common zero-rent scheduler, common buy formula and common tree-DP implementation; common root-star and root-path-union uppers remain shared

build_policy.old_libstdcxx_compatibility: fall back from floating std::from_chars to strtod when the compile-and-link probe fails
build_policy.optimization: Release -O2 (or MSVC /O2); enable IPO/LTO uniformly for repository performance targets only when the toolchain reports support

correctness_gate_dependencies.name: GroupSteinerTree / Basic+
correctness_gate_dependencies.redistribution_note: upstream repository has no repository-level license file

formal_policy.P1_graphs: use the exact processed graph interfaces used by MonoGST+ and GPU4GST
formal_policy.P1_queries: use every author query; no subsampling; preserve query blocks internally but report one aggregate row per graph
formal_policy.P2_queries: related-group BFS candidates on six GPU4GST author graphs for g=5..15; select ten per graph/g cell from five input-size rank strata in two fixed-hash tranches without solver feedback
formal_policy.controlled_queries: MonoGST+ Gaussian-size and uniform-vertex protocol on the exact P1 DBLP-MonoGSTPlus and Toronto-MonoGSTPlus graph identities; g={3,6,9,12,15}, f={200,400,800,1600,3200}, ten queries per cell, seed 20260827; the byte-identical g=15 queries/results are retained and every g is reported separately
formal_policy.future_experiments: the minimal ablations are preregistered separately in experiments/ablation_plan.json and do not enter the formal P1/P2/S2 task count; approximation-quality comparisons are not enabled
formal_policy.historical_reuse: same-binary same-machine completed runs are not rerun; reporting materializes non-destructive 3600-second views, censoring any raw completion above 3600 as timeout while retaining the raw exact outcome only as a correctness reference
formal_policy.method_selection: ABHSS base and enhanced are fixed configurations of one executable; configuration is frozen before a query batch and no per-query oracle is allowed
formal_policy.query_validity: generated P2/S2 and gate queries must have a common intersecting component; published P1 queries are retained in full and known-infeasible rows are audited explicitly
formal_policy.same_name_graphs: DBLP-MonoGSTPlus and DBLP-GPU4GST remain separate identities regardless of similar counts

graph_loading.implementation: shared 8 MiB buffered numeric scanner; solver then performs exact-degree adjacency reservation and one O(n+m) connected-component index build, while the offline feasibility audit streams edges into a DSU
graph_loading.query_feasibility: reuse the immutable component index; connected graphs cost O(total query memberships), disconnected graphs intersect sorted per-group component sets
graph_loading.semantic_contract: preserve original edge order, edge_id, per-vertex adjacency insertion order and finite-double conversion; reject trailing graph tokens
graph_loading.timing_policy: engineering metrics only; excluded from solver query time and algorithmic speedup

reporting_requirements: CPU model, physical cores, RAM, OS, compiler and Release build
one compute thread per solver process
per-query 3600-second timeout and a common graph-load convention
P1: one row per graph with total queries, solved, timeout, error and total time
P1 observed total time is shown only if all queries finish; otherwise show solved time and capped total budget
P2/S2: solved count, PAR-2, mutually solved speedup, timeout direction, objective agreement, peak RSS and completed-query mask_vertex_states
state-count ratios use mutually solved pairs with positive counts; do not impute counts for timeout/error queries
all available exact methods must agree on objective value before a performance claim is used

required_source_archives.name: MonoGST+ author workload
required_source_archives.redistribution_note: the accepted manuscript and author data are not assumed redistributable; publish hashes and acquisition instructions unless permission is obtained

solver_output_contract.mask_vertex_states: ABHSS counts D/A/H row entries when first admitted to a workspace, with the state family included in the key, so equal numeric (mask,v) pairs in different families count separately; common A1 is counted before D exactly once in every legal profile and is not recounted on transfer; PrunedDP++ counts distinct (mask,v) entries actually inserted into StateStore; both exclude group-distance/route/tour/dual preprocessing, duplicate queue items and full-mask completion candidates
solver_output_contract.paper_guardrail: do not claim that the current artifact outputs the tree unless decision reconstruction is implemented and tested
